addons.name: Local AI
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Ollama + Open WebUI on the GPU. Powers the Ask bar and reads ads, postings and bank lines for the hunters, Notes and Money.

addons.name: Armenian
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Anki-style Eastern Armenian: the alphabet, then word packs, with write-it-back cards.

addons.name: Chat
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Full-page chat with Claude (on the host, read-only or Auto) or a local model; chats sync across devices.

addons.name: Cost
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: What Claude, the local GPU and the server cost per day: tokens, watts and euros, next to your plan windows.

addons.name: Deals
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Watches Kleinanzeigen for your keywords, lets the local model judge each ad and pings Discord on a steal.
addons.warning: Scrapes Kleinanzeigen, whose terms forbid automated access. Personal use only, at your own risk.

addons.name: Designs
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Make your own look for the dashboard: colours, a stylesheet and whole skins, or describe one and Claude designs it. Each person picks their own; share with everyone, as a code or on the marketplace.

addons.name: Dev
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Dev boxes as LXCs: projects, previews + public share links, git/GitHub, Claude Code and /ship lanes, web terminals.

addons.name: Flats
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Rental flats from several portals, warm rent worked out, duplicates folded, a landlord message ready to send.
addons.warning: Scrapes Kleinanzeigen, ImmoScout24 (unofficial mobile API) and other portals whose terms forbid automated access. Personal use only, at your own risk.

addons.name: Habits
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Habit tracker with daily, weekly and weekday schedules, streaks, a calendar and a perfect-day celebration.

addons.name: Hunters backend
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: The app behind Deals, Flats and Jobs: polls the portals, lets the local model judge, keeps the feeds. No tab of its own.

addons.name: Jobs
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Reads your CV, polls job portals and scores every posting for fit, with the apply link found for you.
addons.warning: Scrapes job portals (StepStone, LinkedIn, XING and others) whose terms forbid automated access. Personal use only, at your own risk.

addons.name: Kanji
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Anki-style JLPT kanji reviews with stroke-order tracing and write-the-word cards.

addons.name: Learn
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Every Monday Claude writes a one-hour tech lesson pitched at your skill map; finished lessons grow the library.

addons.name: Mail
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Read mail over IMAP and sort it into your own categories (rules first, then the local model, learning from your corrections), draft replies, send only on your confirmation.

addons.name: Media
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: VPN-isolated download stack (*arr, qBittorrent, Seerr) feeding Jellyfin and Audiobookshelf; queues, library, removal.
addons.warning: Downloads through torrent indexers. What you download and whether that is legal where you live is your responsibility.

addons.name: Money
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Firefly III with bank sync: categories, subscriptions, depot, net worth, forecast and a monthly report.
addons.warning: Uses pytr, an unofficial Trade Republic API, and Enable Banking under its personal-use terms. Your bank data, your responsibility.

addons.name: Sidebar order
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Drag the sidebar and phone menu pages into your own order, saved separately for phone, tablet and desktop.

addons.name: Notes
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Quick-capture notebook the local model tidies: one topic per note, todos, pasted images, undo.

addons.name: Research
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Ask a question, pick a depth: your local model searches via SearXNG, reads the pages and writes a cited report in the background.

addons.name: Retro games
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Retro games up to the 3DS era in the browser (phone + PC, EmulatorJS) with saves synced across devices; 3DS streams from Azahar. Free homebrew catalogue + your own game files.
needs: games CT with a /games mount point

addons.name: Game servers
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Minecraft, ARK and Satisfactory servers in Docker: power, console, settings, backups, playit.gg tunnel for friends.

addons.name: Blocky skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A whole-app skin for Designs: a voxel sandbox look with a block landscape, an item hotbar, an inventory grid and achievement toasts.

addons.name: The Bastion Times skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A whole-app skin for Designs: the dashboard as a newspaper, with a masthead, weather ear, section index and article panels.

addons.name: Comic Book skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A whole-app skin for Designs: every page a comic page with caption boxes, inked panels, halftone and sunburst art, and POW! bursts on every button.

addons.name: Disco skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A party skin for Designs that stays readable: a glowing dance floor and a mirror ball, a jukebox page selector, a spinning vinyl tab bar, rainbow card borders and confetti buttons.

addons.name: Liquid Glass skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A whole-app skin for Designs: drifting aurora behind frosted glass cards, a magnifying dock, a capsule tab bar and iOS-style large titles.

addons.name: Grimoire skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A quiet old-book skin for Designs: dark leather and gold rules, serif ink, a ribbon bookmark on the open page, pages as parchment leaves.

addons.name: Kawaii skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A whole-app skin for Designs: pastel sky, a sticker-sheet nav, washi-taped bubble cards and a little cat that cheers you on.

addons.name: Material You skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A whole-app skin for Designs in the style of Android Material 3: top app bar with a navigation drawer, bottom navigation and a navigation rail, tonal cards, ripples and shared-axis page transitions.

addons.name: Retro 95 skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A whole-app skin for Designs: windows with title bars, bevelled buttons and a Start-menu taskbar instead of the sidebar.

addons.name: Synthwave skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A whole-app skin for Designs: 80s outrun with a striped sun, a moving neon grid, neon-tube navigation and VHS glitches.

addons.name: Tactical HUD skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A whole-app skin for Designs: a calm tactical HUD: condensed uppercase type, amber on olive-black, square edges, a numbered loadout column and a weapon-slot tab bar on the phone.

addons.name: Hacker Terminal skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A whole-app skin for Designs: green phosphor terminal with a typed prompt for navigation, box-drawn panels, matrix rain and CRT scanlines.

addons.name: Windows 11 skin
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A whole-app skin for Designs: a centred taskbar with a Start menu, Mica windows with title buttons, an Explorer breadcrumb bar and a blue bloom wallpaper.

addons.name: Trending repos
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: A few fresh GitHub trending repos a day, summed up by your local model and picked against your interests: save to a To-try list, star, or ask about one right on its card.

addons.name: Voice
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Hands-free talking in the chat: it reads the answer aloud, listens, transcribes you and sends the next message.
needs: Local AI (Whisper + Kokoro in the ai CT)

addons.name: Widgets
addons.author: MaxJC0
addons.desc: Build your own Home widgets from an API, metric, service, task or note, or describe one to Claude. Install widget packs from the marketplace.
